title: SLA-driven request routing and cost-sensitivity scoring for Console exports & dashboards
creator: Asha Patel
description:
Problem: Enterprise customers repeatedly request ad-hoc console reports, recurring exports, and dashboard changes with varying urgency and cost implications. Current intake funnels everything into a single queue which causes slow turnaround for SLA-sensitive asks and opaque prioritization for the solutions and data teams.

Goal: Create an SLA-driven routing and cost-sensitivity scoring system that classifies incoming console/reporting requests, surfaces estimated cost and execution risk, and automatically routes high-SLA or high-cost-impact requests to the appropriate team (billing/exports, dashboards, or engineering for infra work). The system should be lightweight to ship within the next quarter and integrate with our existing request form, Console routing rules, and the Dedicated/Private customer tagging.

Non-goals: Full auto-provisioning of export pipelines or replacing existing enterprise onboarding flows. This ticket focuses on triage, routing, and transparency (score + reasoning) rather than end-to-end export implementation.
acceptance_criteria: A documented scoring rubric that converts request attributes (customer tier, SLA target, estimated data size, export cadence, data residency) into a 0-100 priority score
Console request form updated to capture SLA target, data residency, and preferred execution window; changes reviewed by Design and PM

Routing rules implemented: requests with score >=80 created as high-priority tasks and auto-assigned to Solutions (enterprise exports) with SLA label; score 50-79 routed to Product/Analytics queue; <50 routed to backlog
Estimated cost delta (low/medium/high) computed and visible on request details page using telemetry-backed cost model
A short dashboard (Console -> Requests) displays queue size by SLA band, median time-to-assign, and projected monthly cost for pending exports
Integration tests and an internal runbook created; first 3 enterprise requests routed via this system and verified with customers
